summary_1line: Hanuman reassures the despairing Sita that Rama and the monkey army will soon cross the ocean, defeat Ravana, and rescue her.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the Ashoka grove, Sita hands Hanuman her small jewel while he bows with folded palms before departing.
Sita, pale and sorrowful beneath the trees of Lanka, pleads with Hanuman to stay one more day as he prepares to leap away.
Hanuman stands before Sita and confidently gestures toward the distant sea while describing Rama and the vast monkey army coming to Lanka.
